review_scope: Independent read-only engineering review of tabular_contracts and platform_workflow question-scoped integration; not expert scientific labeling.

interpretation: Twelve new descriptive development contracts reuse two source datasets. They do not establish twelve independent studies, source-stated unanswered opportunities, novelty, causal effects or statistical adequacy. Original twelve association contracts remain unchanged and unqualified.
